claim: Source-informed educational simulation candidate; no measured/learned neural-to-muscle decoder, stimulation interface or biological validation supplied.

scientific_conventions.joint_signs: Positive flexion means anatomical flexion, negative change means extension. These are semantic signs, not assumed renderer Euler axes.
scientific_conventions.quantity: Simulated muscle drive and overlay intensity are unitless engineering values; never label them measured EMG, current, spikes, force or BOLD.
scientific_conventions.muscle_state: Activation does not guarantee shortening: muscles can shorten, lengthen or hold length depending on load and movement. Contractile bulging is illustrative unless mechanics/measurements qualify it.
scientific_conventions.coactivation: Allow task-dependent stabilization/braking; never set all antagonists maximally on. Joint torque and imposed animation must agree; no universal recruitment percentages asserted.
scientific_conventions.relaxation: Net grasp drive and stiffness can fall while cortical release control is active. Release, active extension and spreading are separate states.
scientific_conventions.chain: Gaze/WASD → virtual action selector → schematic simulated motor drive → muscle-role display → joint/pose model → displacement; this is not a measured neural chain.

cortical_display_contract.primary_target: RIGHT precentral upper-limb motor territory near hand knob, especially M1 on the anterior/precentral bank of central sulcus.
cortical_display_contract.precentral_not_equal_M1: FJ1801 is an anatomical right precentral mesh according to parent assignment, pending asset-owner verification. Whole precentral gyrus is not cytoarchitectonic BA4; crown may include BA6/premotor cortex (DEO2026).
exclude: Do not relabel postcentral S1 as M1.
Do not label every precentral vertex as motor output cortex.
Do not use face/leg/SCAN regions as invented isolated hand hotspots.

orientation.coordinate_definition: An optional internal RAS frame means +X subject right, +Y anterior, +Z superior. Asset coordinates require a verified transform; none is supplied here.
orientation.mandatory: Label anatomical R/L and anterior/posterior; verify with mesh metadata/landmarks. Never infer laterality only from screen side or mirror a literature coordinate blindly.

cortical_display_contract.field_design: Show overlapping broad response fields with relative action preference. Multiple representative grasp/retraction and digit preferences may recur within hand territory. Wrist/arm fields overlap and can bracket hand emphasis; do not impose a single continuous homunculus strip.
cortical_display_contract.specificity: Specific action selection is justified; exact field coordinates are not. A selectable labelled representative action marker can choose an action while its activity overlay remains overlapping and nonexclusive.
cortical_display_contract.marker_rule: A marker is an educational control target, not a measured hotspot. Avoid 12 sharply bounded, mutually exclusive one-action cortical islands.
cortical_display_contract.minimum_qualifier_visible: Representative motor map · regions overlap and vary between people
cortical_display_contract.release_marker: Representative release control within the overlapping hand field; no unique inhibitory/relaxation centre claimed. Colour may denote release-control state while flexor net-drive display falls.
cortical_display_contract.confidence_display: Separate action/anatomy support from spatial registration. Expose sources per action and identify compound spread as anatomical inference. No invented percentage certainty.
cortical_display_contract.resolution: Do not transplant published voxel sizes, measured patch sizes, group coordinates or TMS scalp-map distances as this mesh’s functional accuracy.
cortical_display_contract.release_hold_condition: Root/source reviewer verifies anatomical laterality and central-sulcus landmarks and accepts clearly labelled representative placement. A claim of measured functional registration requires an independent registered individual map and task-specific validation; not provided.

actions.label: Grasp / close hand

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Overlapping, repeated action/digit preference fields within the right precentral hand region. Fine research measurements do not transfer coordinates to FJ1801.

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: Unloaded virtual grasp is a coordinated posture. Wrist extensors may oppose digital-flexor wrist torque; do not force wrist flexion with every grasp. Extensors may coactivate for stability, but must not be fixed at maximal drive. No object/contact force is validated.

actions.label: Relax / release grasp

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Shared hand motor-control circuitry, not a separate proven relaxation centre; release control must be labelled representative.

sources.evidence: Fig.4–6; inhibitory control and both FDS/EDC reduction
Fig.1B and first Results paragraph; release without antagonist command

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: Decrease grasp drive and stiffness. Passive mechanics can soften a grasp but do not guarantee a fully straight or spread hand. If the displayed hand actively opens/spreads, transition to open_hand and spread_fingers with active extensor/abductor roles. Neural release control can remain active while net flexor drive falls.

actions.label: Open hand / extend fingers

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Overlapping, repeated action/digit preference fields within the right precentral hand region. Fine research measurements do not transfer coordinates to FJ1801.

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: This is active opening, distinct from release. Intrinsics contribute IP extension while also flexing MCP; keep roles joint-specific. Stop before hyperextension; no claim that every extensor shortens in every phase.

actions.label: Spread fingers

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Shared right hand region. Index-abduction human evidence plus anatomical multi-digit coordination; no measured unique all-finger-spread cortical patch.

sources.evidence: Fig.1,4–6; human index abduction, both hands
Fig.2–3; overlapping hand/digit territories, not a whole-hand spread map

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: Digit abduction is defined relative to the third digit, not screen left/right. The four dorsal interossei act on digits2–4; ADM abducts digit5. This fan is an anatomical compound simulation, not an empirically registered all-digit neural synergy. Opening can accompany it but is a separate command.

actions.label: Flex wrist

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Broad overlapping wrist/hand response field with possible task-specific biases; no universal wrist-flexion versus wrist-extension point.

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: Balance radial/ulnar flexors qualitatively for a flexion command. Digital flexors may assist but must not impose a grasp; fingers can remain independently posed. Anatomical torque signs are not measured recruitment weights.

actions.label: Extend wrist

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Broad overlapping wrist/hand response field with possible task-specific biases; no universal wrist-flexion versus wrist-extension point.

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: Balance radial/ulnar extensor tendencies. ED can assist but fingers need not all extend maximally. Any passive finger motion from tenodesis requires actual tendon mechanics; do not invent a neural association from it.

actions.label: Flex elbow

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Overlapping proximal-arm preferences around the hand territory; no separately validated elbow-flexion versus elbow-extension centre on this mesh.

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: Biceps also supinates; brachialis flexes across forearm rotation. In a pure elbow command, hold pronation/supination separately. Use limited antagonist stabilization and reduce it relative to flexor torque.

actions.label: Extend elbow

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Overlapping proximal-arm preferences around the hand territory; no separately validated elbow-flexion versus elbow-extension centre on this mesh.

sources.evidence: Fig.3; proximal-arm organization only, not extension-specific locus

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: Extension is elbow rotation, not simply screen-forward translation. Flexors may brake eccentrically; do not require zero flexor activity or call all active muscle shortening. Stop before hyperextension.

actions.label: Flex index finger

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Overlapping, repeated action/digit preference fields within the right precentral hand region. Fine research measurements do not transfer coordinates to FJ1801.

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: Recruit the index-relevant FDS/FDP portions. Shared muscle/tendon anatomy means perfect digit isolation is not assured. Freeze other simulated digits only as a control simplification, not a demonstrated biological capability.

actions.label: Extend index finger

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Overlapping, repeated action/digit preference fields within the right precentral hand region. Fine research measurements do not transfer coordinates to FJ1801.

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: EI/ED plus the extensor apparatus support extension; intrinsic assistance is joint-dependent. Its cortical field overlaps index flexion rather than occupying a falsely isolated universal point.

actions.label: Flex thumb at MCP

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Overlapping, repeated action/digit preference fields within the right precentral hand region. Fine research measurements do not transfer coordinates to FJ1801.

sources.evidence: Fig.1–3; direction-biased thumb fields with free MCP

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: MCP flexion is distinct from opposition or IP flexion. FPL crosses the MCP but principally governs IP flexion; do not display maximal FPL drive while claiming isolated MCP motion without compensation.

actions.label: Extend thumb at MCP

cortical.spatial_resolution_justified: Overlapping, repeated action/digit preference fields within the right precentral hand region. Fine research measurements do not transfer coordinates to FJ1801.

sources.evidence: Fig.1–3; direction-biased thumb fields with free MCP

actions.mechanical_and_relaxation_note: EPB extends MCP. EPL can contribute through its path but chiefly extends IP; avoid conflating thumb retraction, radial abduction, opposition and MCP extension.

composition_and_conflict_rules: Grasp and open are competing finger targets. Space held selects fist; release immediately selects active opening and clears any stale grasp pulse. A distinct relax_release action may reduce drive without extension, but never replaces the mandatory Space-release opening. Gaze/click actions after release may choose a new target.
Open plus spread is allowed as a coordinated compound. Increased aperture comes from joint rotation; no literal tissue growth or unexplained muscle expansion.
Wrist and digit commands can coexist with tendon/mechanical coupling stated. Elbow commands remain separately composable within rig reach/collision limits.

WASD moves the virtual reach target; screen direction is not a cortical coordinate or a single-muscle label. A shoulder/arm inverse-kinematic controller is outside this finite hand/elbow map and must retain separate mechanics/source qualification.
Gaze hover selects a virtual action; any dwell, gain, animation timing or smoothing is a UI choice, not a physiological latency or stimulation dose.
Current hand screen-height and whole-hand FOV constraints remain mandatory across all poses, depth, camera motion and resize. This source integration does not verify rendered behavior.
acceptance_before_live_adoption: Root independently collects and checks this exact version and citation snapshots.
Asset owner confirms human LEFT anatomy, rights, actual muscles/bones and anatomical RIGHT precentral identity. No monkey-to-human relabelling.
Renderer verifies subject laterality, anterior-top/posterior-bottom and actual precentral-versus-postcentral selection; FJ1801 is not advertised as a measured BA4 subpatch atlas.
Each action visibly changes its named joints with correct signs and muscle roles, including release versus active opening/spreading; joint-dependent intrinsic roles are preserved.
No maximal-antagonist lock, invalid rig axes, mesh detachment, tissue growth, extreme joint deformation or unqualified quantitative physiology.
Actual browser/WebGL/control combinations/full-hand FOV/font/latency/output/export/reference-series/held-out and independent acceptance remain separate; this artifact does not pass them.
holds: Exact individual cortical registration is unsupported/HOLD.
Live anatomical rig, rendering and clinical/real-stimulation claims are unadmitted.
All inherited genuine input/auth/safety/funds/budget/quota/unknown-ACK and scientific/rights/held-out gates remain.

current_control_overlay.authority: Current genuine originals supersede only conflicting earlier optional UI choices; all reviewed action anatomy and uncertainty remain.
current_control_overlay.space_keydown_and_held: Select grasp_close for all five digits including thumb opposition. Finger target remains a fist for the entire hold. Wrist/elbow commands may compose within anatomical limits.
current_control_overlay.space_keyup: Immediately replace the finger target with open_hand for all five digits and display corresponding simulated opening drive. Begin opening in the next animation update; finite visible joint motion is permitted. Active opening is mandatory, not merely passive relaxation or optional extension.
current_control_overlay.release_precedence: Clear any earlier grasp-directed gaze/click finger pulse on Space release so stale state cannot reclose the hand on the next frame. New deliberate valid gaze movement or click after release may select a new action.
current_control_overlay.input_clocks: Held WASD/Space drive and one-second gaze/click pulses have separate state. Gaze timeout must not end a held key action; held keys must not refresh a stationary gaze pulse.
current_control_overlay.gaze_event: Entering a new valid representative motor target, or a qualifying view movement on it, starts a one-second pulse. Stationary gaze expires after one second. Do not refresh it from the render loop.
current_control_overlay.click_event: Each left or right trackpad click on the current valid motor target retriggers one second from the event. Holding a button is not an indefinite pulse. Suppress the context menu within the game surface.
current_control_overlay.empty_space: A ray miss starts no gaze/click activation. Movement and Space still cause their own linked activation.
current_control_overlay.wasd: W/S control reach depth, A/D the horizontal screen relation; simultaneous keys compose, opposite keys cancel on the corresponding axis. Show linked representative arm/hand activation without inventing a one-muscle or unique cortical-point encoding.
current_control_overlay.screen_constraint: Hand anchor height stays at the screen mid-height. Only A/D changes its horizontal screen relation; view yaw/pitch and finger/wrist/elbow pose changes must not introduce independent horizontal anchor drift. Pose deformation changes the silhouette around that anchor. Clamp the entire current posed hand including fingertips/thumb within the viewport, using the feasible A/D range or camera-relative fit at every supported depth/aspect/resize while preserving the anchor constraints.
current_control_overlay.selective_visibility: Only representative RIGHT upper-limb motor territory relevant to LEFT hand/arm is clear and color-coded. Remaining brain stays glassy. FJ1801 is an anatomical anchor, not an all-M1 mesh; no whole-precentral activation or false functional registration.
current_control_overlay.arm_hand_language: User game requests use hand/arm inclusively; anatomical joint and muscle labels remain specific.
current_control_overlay.visual_quantities: Color is unitless simulated drive. Never label it measured electrical current, EMG, neural firing, force or a validated NeuroTranslate prediction.
